title: Mechanism of EnT-mediated amino-sulfonylation of alkenes with N-sulfonyl ketimine: a DFT investigation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15724-15728
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02290H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Peng Chen, Xin-Yuan Jiang, Kai Chen
DFT studies were conducted to depict the free energy profile of the EnT-mediated 1,2-sulfonylamination of styrene with bifunctional reagent N-sulfonyl ketimine. The electronic properties of the generated iminyl and tosyl radicals were analyzed.
